### MS-GLUTAMATE META-ANALYSIS: STEP 2 ###

"Brain glutamate, disease burden, and neuropsychiatric symptoms in multiple sclerosis: a meta-analysis"

This is the second script (out of two), to run the statistical analyses for the ms-glutamate meta-analysis project. This script uses the meta-analyses from script 1 to run moderate analyses, meta-regressions, figures, and sensitivity analyses. 

Pre: 
- Script 1 (ms_glutamate_metaanalysis/scripts/ms_glu_meta_analysis_p1_git.Rmd).
- Update base_dir to reflect local environment.
- Ensure that all packages (listed in stage 1: setup chunk) have been previously downloaded.
- Have the meta-analysis data (github: ms_glutamate_metaanalysis/data/) downloaded and loaded into the appropriate folder.

Post:
- All statistical analyses and figures needed to replicate the meta-analysis. 

<https://bookdown.org/MathiasHarrer/Doing_Meta_Analysis_in_R/> Citation:
Harrer, M., Cuijpers, P., Furukawa, T.A., & Ebert, D.D. (2021). Doing Meta-Analysis with R: A Hands-On Guide. Boca Raton, FL and London: Chapman & Hall/CRC Press. ISBN 978-0-367-61007-4.

# ----------------------------------------------
#### Setup
```{r setup-packages}
# Set paths
base_dir   <- "/Users/elenacooper/Desktop/MS_Meta_Analysis" # update this path to reflect your local environment
results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "/final_results")

# Load packages
load_packages <- function(packages) {
  for (pkg in packages) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(pkg)
    }
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

packages_needed <- c(
  "readxl", "writexl", "tidyverse", "grid", "gridExtra", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "gt", "webshot2", "gridGraphics",
  "ggpattern", "knitr", "esc", "metafor", "meta", "dmetar", "DeLuciatoR", "RColorBrewer", "ggsignif", "broom", "cowplot"
)

load_packages(packages_needed)

```

### Stage 3: Load data, create functions, and explore moderator effects
#### Load datasets
```{r}
# Load raw data
dataset_all <- read_xlsx(paste0(results_dir,"/DATASET_all_metabolites.xlsx"))
dataset_glu <- read_xlsx(paste0(results_dir,"/DATASET_Glu.xlsx"))
dataset_glx <- read_xlsx(paste0(results_dir,"/DATASET_Glx.xlsx"))

# Load the meta results 
meta_results <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/meta_OVERALL_all_metabolites.rds"))
meta_results_glu <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/meta_Glu.rds"))
meta_results_glx <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/meta_Glx.rds"))

metab_metaresults <- list(
  Glu = meta_results_glu,
  Glx = meta_results_glx
)

# Define the metabolites
all_metabolites <- c("Glu", "Glx")

```

##### Edit Data
```{r}
# Create a list for cortical and sub-cortical regions
cortical_region_order <- c("Frontal", "Temporal", "Occipital", "Parietal")
subcortical_region_order <- c("Thalamus", "Basal Ganglia", "Hypothalamus")

# Create cortical and sub-cortical groupings in all dataframes
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(Brain_Division = case_when(
    Cortical %in% cortical_region_order ~ "Cortical",
    Sub_Cortical %in% subcortical_region_order ~ "Subcortical",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

dataset_glu <- dataset_glu %>%
  mutate(Brain_Division = case_when(
    Cortical %in% cortical_region_order ~ "Cortical",
    Sub_Cortical %in% subcortical_region_order ~ "Subcortical",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

dataset_glx <- dataset_glx %>%
  mutate(Brain_Division = case_when(
    Cortical %in% cortical_region_order ~ "Cortical",
    Sub_Cortical %in% subcortical_region_order ~ "Subcortical",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
```

# ----------------------------------------------
#### Create Functions
The functions created below are also available as a separate R script (glu_meta_analysis_functions.R) on the github project page.

##### run_baseline_meta_pipeline
```{r}
run_baseline_meta_pipeline <- function(results_dir, metab_colors = c("Glu" = "#C76B72", "Glx" = "#E6B65E", "Overall" = "#05668d")) {
  
  if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  dataset_all <- bind_rows(
    if(exists("dataset_glu")) dataset_glu %>% mutate(Neurometabolite_Type = "Glu") else NULL,
    if(exists("dataset_glx")) dataset_glx %>% mutate(Neurometabolite_Type = "Glx") else NULL
  )
  
### Compute Primary Estimates ###
  
  # Overall 
  overall_meta <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = dataset_all, studlab = Study,
                          common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
  
  sink(file.path(results_dir, "Overall_Metabolite_Stats_Full.txt"))
  cat("--- OVERALL META-ANALYSIS (ALL METABOLITES COMBINED) ---\n")
  print(summary(overall_meta))
  sink()
  
  # Build baseline table
  metabolites <- c("Glu", "Glx")
  meta_results_table <- data.frame()
  
  for (m in metabolites) {
    df_sub <- dataset_all %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type == m)
    if (nrow(df_sub) >= 3) {
      m_meta <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = df_sub, studlab = Study,
                        common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
      meta_results_table <- rbind(meta_results_table, data.frame(
        Metabolite = m, k = m_meta$k, Effect_Size = as.numeric(m_meta$TE.random),
        Lower = as.numeric(m_meta$lower.random), Upper = as.numeric(m_meta$upper.random),
        P_Value = as.numeric(m_meta$pval.random), Q_Stat = as.numeric(m_meta$Q),
        Q_P_Value = as.numeric(m_meta$pval.Q), I2 = as.numeric(m_meta$I2) * 100, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Append overall row
  overall_row <- data.frame(
    Metabolite = "Overall", k = overall_meta$k, Effect_Size = as.numeric(overall_meta$TE.random),
    Lower = as.numeric(overall_meta$lower.random), Upper = as.numeric(overall_meta$upper.random),
    P_Value = as.numeric(overall_meta$pval.random), Q_Stat = as.numeric(overall_meta$Q),
    Q_P_Value = as.numeric(overall_meta$pval.Q), I2 = as.numeric(overall_meta$I2) * 100, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  meta_results_table <- bind_rows(overall_row, meta_results_table) %>%
    mutate(
      Stars = case_when(P_Value < 0.001 ~ "***", P_Value < 0.01 ~ "**", P_Value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
      Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = c("Overall", "Glu", "Glx"))
    )
  
### Post-Hoc Pairwise Comparisons ###
  
  metab_levels <- unique(as.character(dataset_all$Neurometabolite_Type))
  pairwise_results <- data.frame()
  
  if (length(metab_levels) >= 2) {
    level_pairs <- utils::combn(metab_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    for (pair in level_pairs) {
      p_subset <- dataset_all %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type %in% pair)
      try({
        comp_meta_base <- metagen(TE = SDM, 
                                  seTE = `SDM Std Err`, 
                                  data = p_subset, 
                                  common = FALSE, 
                                  random = TRUE, 
                                  method.tau = "DL", 
                                  sm = "SMD")
        comp_meta <- update(comp_meta_base, subgroup = p_subset$Neurometabolite_Type)
        pairwise_results <- rbind(pairwise_results, data.frame(
                                  Group_1 = pair[1], 
                                  Group_2 = pair[2], 
                                  Q_Between = comp_meta$Q.b.random, 
                                  P_Value = comp_meta$pval.Q.b.random, 
                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(pairwise_results) > 0) {
    pairwise_results$FDR_p <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$P_Value, method = "fdr")
  }
  
### Figures and Tables ###
  
  # Main bar plot (excluding overall)
  fig_main_results <- ggplot(meta_results_table %>% filter(Metabolite != "Overall"), 
                             aes(x = Metabolite, y = Effect_Size, fill = Metabolite)) + 
    geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey30") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Stars, y = Upper + 0.05), size = 6, fontface = "bold", vjust = 0) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("k=", k), y = Lower - 0.1), size = 4, fontface = "italic") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Pooled Effect Size (SMD)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = metab_colors) +
    labs(title = "Summary of Metabolite Changes") +
    theme_linedraw() + 
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5), axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12), 
      axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5) 
    )
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(results_dir, "Figure_Main_Meta_Summary.pdf"), plot = fig_main_results, width = 7, height = 5)
  writexl::write_xlsx(list(Main_Results = meta_results_table, Pairwise_Comparisons = pairwise_results), file.path(results_dir, "Table_Main_Meta_Results.xlsx"))
  
  # Generate presentation table
  if (nrow(pairwise_results) > 0) {
    post_hoc_table <- pairwise_results %>%
      select(Group_1, Group_2, Q_Between, P_Value, FDR_p) %>%
      gt() %>%
      tab_header(title = "Post-Hoc Pairwise Comparisons Between Metabolites") %>%
      cols_label(Group_1 = "Metabolite", Group_2 = "Comparison", Q_Between = "Q-Statistic", P_Value = "p-value", FDR_p = "FDR Adjusted p") %>%
      fmt_number(columns = c(Q_Between), decimals = 2) %>%
      fmt_number(columns = c(P_Value, FDR_p), decimals = 3) %>%
      tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
      tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "#f8f9fa"), locations = cells_body(rows = FDR_p < 0.05)) %>%
      tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#A11332", weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = FDR_p, rows = FDR_p < 0.05)) %>%
      tab_options(table.border.top.color = "black", column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black", table.width = pct(80))
    
    gtsave(data = post_hoc_table, filename = file.path(results_dir, "Table_PostHoc_Final.pdf"))
  }
  
  # Total sample printout
  total_sample_size <- dataset_all %>%
    distinct(Study_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(Total_Cases = sum(Case_Sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),
              Total_Controls = sum(Control_Sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),
              Grand_Total = Total_Cases + Total_Controls)
  
  print(total_sample_size)
  
  return(list(summary_table = meta_results_table, pairwise = pairwise_results))
}

```

##### run_categorical_moderator_pipeline
```{r}
run_categorical_moderator_pipeline <- function(subgroup_var, 
                                               subgroup_name, 
                                               results_dir, 
                                               x_axis_order = NULL) {
  
  safe_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]", "_", subgroup_name)
  output_path <- file.path(results_dir, "Moderator_Analyses", safe_name)
  if (!dir.exists(output_path)) dir.create(output_path, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Plot Theme
  pipeline_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 18) + 
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
    )
  
### Overall Analysis (dataset_all) ###
  
  df_overall <- dataset_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(subgroup_var)), !is.na(SDM)) %>%
    group_by(!!sym(subgroup_var)) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  overall_output <- NULL
  
  if (nrow(df_overall) > 0) {
    meta_overall <- metagen(
      TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = df_overall, studlab = Study,
      common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD",
      subgroup = df_overall[[subgroup_var]]
    )
    
    n_counts_overall <- df_overall %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subgroup_var)) %>%
      summarise(k = n(), N_studies = n_distinct(Study_ID), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      rename(subgroup = !!sym(subgroup_var))
    
    summary_overall <- data.frame(
      subgroup = names(meta_overall$k.w),
      estimate = as.numeric(meta_overall$TE.random.w),      
      p_value = as.numeric(meta_overall$pval.random.w),     
      conf.low = as.numeric(meta_overall$lower.random.w),   
      conf.high = as.numeric(meta_overall$upper.random.w),  
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      left_join(n_counts_overall, by = "subgroup") %>%
      mutate(
        significance = case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01 ~ "**", p_value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"),
        plot_label = paste0(subgroup, "\n(k=", k, ")")
      )
    
    # Plot Overall
    p_overall <- ggplot(summary_overall, aes(x = plot_label, y = estimate)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#5F6DAE", colour = "black", width = 0.6) + 
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey30") + 
      geom_text(aes(y = conf.high + 0.05, label = ifelse(significance == "ns", "", significance)), size = 6) +
      labs(title = paste("Overall Effect of", subgroup_name), x = NULL, y = "Pooled SMD") +
      pipeline_theme
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_path, "Overall_Subgroup_Plot.png"), p_overall, width = 8, height = 6)
    
    overall_output <- list(model = meta_overall, table_data = summary_overall)
  }
  
### Split by Metabolite (glutamate & glutamate+glutamine) ###
  
  metabolite_datasets <- list(
    Glu = if(exists("dataset_glu")) dataset_glu else NULL,
    Glx = if(exists("dataset_glx")) dataset_glx else NULL
  )
  metabolite_datasets <- metabolite_datasets[!sapply(metabolite_datasets, is.null)]
  
  summary_list <- list()
  all_pairwise_results <- data.frame()
  metab_colors <- c("Glu" = "#C76B72", "Glx" = "#E6B65E")
  
  for (metab in names(metabolite_datasets)) {
    df_current <- metabolite_datasets[[metab]] %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(subgroup_var)))
    if (nrow(df_current) < 3) next
    
    meta_sub <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = df_current, studlab = Study,
                        common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
    meta_subgroup <- update(meta_sub, subgroup = df_current[[subgroup_var]], subgroup.name = subgroup_name)
    
    # Save Text Summary
    sink(file.path(output_path, paste0("meta_results_", metab, ".txt")))
    cat(paste0("Analysis for Metabolite: ", metab, "\n"))
    print(summary(meta_subgroup))
    sink()
    
    n_counts_sub <- df_current %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subgroup_var)) %>%
      summarise(
        k = n(), N_studies = n_distinct(Study_ID),
        Total_N_Case = sum(distinct(pick(Study_ID, Case_Sample_size))$Case_Sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),
        Total_N_Control = sum(distinct(pick(Study_ID, Control_Sample_size))$Control_Sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>% rename(subgroup = !!sym(subgroup_var))
    
    if (!is.null(meta_subgroup$bylevs)) {
      summary_df <- data.frame(
        Neurometabolite_Type = metab,
        subgroup = as.character(meta_subgroup$bylevs),
        Effect_Size = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$TE.random.w),
        Lower = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$lower.random.w),
        Upper = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$upper.random.w),
        Pvalue = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$pval.random.w),
        Q_stat = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$Q.w),    
        I2 = as.numeric(meta_subgroup$I2.w) * 100,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        left_join(n_counts_sub, by = "subgroup") %>%
        mutate(
          plot_label = paste0(subgroup, "\n(k=", k, ", N=", N_studies, ")\n", "C/H: ", Total_N_Case, "/", Total_N_Control),
          Significance_Stars = case_when(Pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***", Pvalue < 0.01  ~ "**", Pvalue < 0.05  ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")
        )
      
      summary_list[[metab]] <- summary_df
      
      # Plot individual metabolite
      p_metab <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = plot_label, y = Effect_Size, fill = Neurometabolite_Type)) +
        geom_col(colour = "black", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.1) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey30") + 
        geom_text(aes(y = Upper + 0.05, label = Significance_Stars), size = 6) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = metab_colors) + 
        labs(title = paste("Average Effect Size:", metab), subtitle = paste("Moderator:", subgroup_name), x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (SMD)") +
        pipeline_theme
      
      ggsave(file.path(output_path, paste0(metab, "_Subgroup_Plot.png")), p_metab, width = 7, height = 6)
      
      # Pairwise Comparisons
      mod_levels <- as.character(meta_subgroup$bylevs)
      if (length(mod_levels) >= 2) {
        level_pairs <- utils::combn(mod_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
        for (pair in level_pairs) {
          pair_df <- df_current[df_current[[subgroup_var]] %in% pair, ]
          try({
            pair_base <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = pair_df, common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
            pair_meta <- update(pair_base, subgroup = pair_df[[subgroup_var]])
            all_pairwise_results <- rbind(all_pairwise_results, data.frame(
              Metabolite = metab, Group_1 = pair[1], Group_2 = pair[2],
              Q_Test = pair_meta$Q.b.random, P_Value = pair_meta$pval.Q.b.random, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            ))
          }, silent = TRUE)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
### Combined Cross-Metabolite Plot & Excel Extraction ###
  
  excel_out_list <- list()
  
  if (length(summary_list) > 0) { 
    combined_summary <- bind_rows(summary_list) %>%
      mutate(Neurometabolite_Type = factor(Neurometabolite_Type, levels = c("Glu", "Glx"))) %>%
      arrange(Neurometabolite_Type)
    
    excel_out_list$Subgroup_Stats <- combined_summary
    
    if (length(summary_list) > 1) {
      comp_plot <- ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = plot_label, y = Effect_Size, fill = Neurometabolite_Type)) +
        geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), colour = "black", width = 0.7) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.1) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = metab_colors, name = "Metabolite") +
        geom_text(aes(y = Upper + 0.1, label = Significance_Stars), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
        labs(title = paste("Metabolite Comparison:", subgroup_name), x = NULL, y = "Effect Size (SMD)") +
        pipeline_theme + theme(legend.position = "right")
      
      ggsave(file.path(output_path, "Comparison_Across_Metabolites_Plot.png"), comp_plot, width = 12, height = 7)
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(all_pairwise_results) > 0) {
    all_pairwise_results$FDR_p <- p.adjust(all_pairwise_results$P_Value, method = "fdr")
    excel_out_list$Pairwise_Comparisons <- all_pairwise_results
  }
  
  if (length(excel_out_list) > 0) {
    write_xlsx(excel_out_list, path = file.path(output_path, paste0(safe_name, "_Results_Summary.xlsx")))
  }
  
  return(list(overall = overall_output, metabolites = summary_list)) 
}

```

##### run_continuous_regression_pipeline
```{r}
run_continuous_regression_pipeline <- function(df, moderator, moderator_name, results_dir) {
  
  safe_mod_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]", "_", gsub("#", "Number", gsub("%", "Percent", moderator_name)))
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(moderator))) %>%
    mutate(temp_mod = as.numeric(!!sym(moderator))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(temp_mod))
  
  if (nrow(df_clean) < 3) {
    message(paste("Skipping Regressions for", moderator, ": Too few studies."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  pub_theme <- theme_linedraw() + 
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), legend.position   = "bottom"
    )
  
  plot_list <- list()
  
### Overall Regression (All metabolites combined) ###
  
  overall_folder <- file.path(results_dir, "Overall_Regressions", safe_mod_name)
  if (!dir.exists(overall_folder)) dir.create(overall_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  
  reg_overall <- rma(yi = SDM, sei = `SDM Std Err`, mods = ~ temp_mod, data = df_clean, method = "DL")
  p_val_ov <- reg_overall$pval[2]
  p_label_ov <- if (p_val_ov < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(p_val_ov, 3))
  
  results_txt <- paste0("Analysis: OVERALL (All Metabolites Combined)\nModerator: ", moderator_name, 
                        "\nk (obs): ", nrow(df_clean), "\nN (studies): ", n_distinct(df_clean$Study_ID),
                        "\nSlope: ", round(reg_overall$b[2], 4), "\nP-value: ", p_label_ov)
  writeLines(results_txt, file.path(overall_folder, paste0("Overall_Summary_", safe_mod_name, ".txt")))
  
  p_overall <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = temp_mod, y = SDM)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
    geom_point(aes(size = 1/`SDM Std Err`), shape = 21, fill = "#26547c", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", fill = "grey90", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = paste("Overall Analysis vs", moderator_name),
         subtitle = paste0("Slope = ", round(reg_overall$b[2], 3), " | ", p_label_ov),
         x = moderator_name, y = "Effect Size (SMD)", size = "Precision (1/SE)") +
    pub_theme
  
  ggsave(file.path(overall_folder, paste0("Overall_Plot_", safe_mod_name, ".png")), p_overall, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  plot_list[["Overall"]] <- p_overall

### Individual Metabolite Regressions and Interaction Model ###
  
  split_folder <- file.path(results_dir, "Regression_Glu_vs_Glx", safe_mod_name)
  if (!dir.exists(split_folder)) dir.create(split_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  
  metab_colors <- c("Glu" = "#C76B72", "Glx" = "#E6B65E")
  
  for (metab in c("Glu", "Glx")) {
    metab_df <- df_clean %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type == metab)
    if (nrow(metab_df) <= 2) next
    
    reg_indiv <- rma(yi = SDM, sei = `SDM Std Err`, mods = ~ temp_mod, data = metab_df, method = "DL")
    variable_p <- if (reg_indiv$pval[2] < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", round(reg_indiv$pval[2], 3))
    
    sink(file.path(split_folder, paste0(metab, "_Meta_Regression.txt")))
    cat(paste0("--- ", metab, " META-REGRESSION ---\nk = ", nrow(metab_df), "\n"))
    print(summary(reg_indiv))
    sink()
    
    p_indiv <- ggplot(metab_df, aes(x = temp_mod, y = SDM)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, fill = metab_colors[metab], color = "black") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.4) +
      labs(title = paste0(metab, " Meta-Regression: ", moderator_name),
           subtitle = paste0("Slope=", round(reg_indiv$b[2], 3), " | ", variable_p),
           x = moderator_name, y = "Effect Size (SMD)") +
      pub_theme
    
    ggsave(file.path(split_folder, paste0(metab, "_Plot.png")), p_indiv, width = 7, height = 5)
    plot_list[[metab]] <- p_indiv
  }
  
  # Interaction / Comparison Model
  if (length(unique(df_clean$Neurometabolite_Type)) >= 2) {
    reg_int <- rma(yi = SDM, sei = `SDM Std Err`, mods = ~ temp_mod * Neurometabolite_Type, data = df_clean, method = "DL")
    write.csv(as.data.frame(coef(summary(reg_int))), file.path(split_folder, "Interaction_Comparison_Results.csv"))
    
    comp_plot <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = temp_mod, y = SDM, color = Neurometabolite_Type, fill = Neurometabolite_Type)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      geom_point(aes(size = 1/`SDM Std Err`), shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.1, fullrange = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = metab_colors) + scale_fill_manual(values = metab_colors) +
      labs(title = paste("Comparison Across Metabolites:", moderator_name), subtitle = "Interaction Model Line Fit",
           x = moderator_name, y = "Effect Size (SMD)", size = "Precision (1/SE)") +
      pub_theme
    
    ggsave(file.path(split_folder, "Comparison_Interaction_Plot.png"), comp_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
    plot_list[["Comparison"]] <- comp_plot
  }
  
  return(plot_list)
}
```

##### run_metabolite_comparison_stats
```{r}
run_metabolite_comparison_stats <- function(subgroup_var) {
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(
    if(exists("dataset_glu")) dataset_glu else NULL,
    if(exists("dataset_glx")) dataset_glx else NULL
  )
  
  combined_data <- combined_data %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(subgroup_var)))
  
  diff_stats <- data.frame()
  subtypes <- unique(combined_data[[subgroup_var]])
  
  for (s in subtypes) {
    sub_df <- combined_data %>% filter(!!sym(subgroup_var) == s)
    
    metab_count <- length(unique(sub_df$Neurometabolite_Type))
    
    if(nrow(sub_df) > 3 & metab_count > 1) {
      try({
        res <- rma(yi = SDM, sei = `SDM Std Err`, 
                   mods = ~ Neurometabolite_Type, 
                   data = sub_df, method = "DL")
        
        diff_stats <- rbind(diff_stats, data.frame(
          subgroup = s,
          Q_Value = res$QM,
          P_Value = res$QMp,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  return(diff_stats)
}
```

##### Overall Glutamate vs Glutamate+Glutamine Finding
```{r}
dataset_all <- bind_rows(
  if(exists("dataset_glu")) dataset_glu %>% mutate(Neurometabolite_Type = "Glu") else NULL,
  if(exists("dataset_glx")) dataset_glx %>% mutate(Neurometabolite_Type = "Glx") else NULL
)

### Run Meta-analysis
overall_meta <- metagen(
  TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = dataset_all, studlab = Study,
  common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD"
)

metabolite_types <- c("Glu", "Glx")
meta_results_table <- data.frame()

for (m in metabolite_types) {
  df_sub <- dataset_all %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type == m)
  if (nrow(df_sub) >= 3) {
    m_meta <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = df_sub, studlab = Study,
                      common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
    meta_results_table <- rbind(meta_results_table, data.frame(
      Metabolite = m, k = m_meta$k, Effect_Size = as.numeric(m_meta$TE.random),
      Lower = as.numeric(m_meta$lower.random), Upper = as.numeric(m_meta$upper.random),
      P_Value = as.numeric(m_meta$pval.random), Q_Stat = as.numeric(m_meta$Q),
      Q_P_Value = as.numeric(m_meta$pval.Q), I2 = as.numeric(m_meta$I2) * 100, 
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

overall_row <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = "Overall", k = overall_meta$k, Effect_Size = as.numeric(overall_meta$TE.random),
  Lower = as.numeric(overall_meta$lower.random), Upper = as.numeric(overall_meta$upper.random),
  P_Value = as.numeric(overall_meta$pval.random), Q_Stat = as.numeric(overall_meta$Q),
  Q_P_Value = as.numeric(overall_meta$pval.Q), I2 = as.numeric(overall_meta$I2) * 100, 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta_results_table <- bind_rows(overall_row, meta_results_table) %>%
  mutate(
    Stars = case_when(P_Value < 0.001 ~ "***", P_Value < 0.01 ~ "**", P_Value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"),
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = c("Overall", "Glu", "Glx"))
  )

### Post-Hoc Pairwise Metabolite Comparisons ###

metab_levels <- unique(as.character(dataset_all$Neurometabolite_Type))
pairwise_results <- data.frame()

if (length(metab_levels) >= 2) {
  level_pairs <- utils::combn(metab_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (pair in level_pairs) {
    p_subset <- dataset_all %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type %in% pair)
    try({
      comp_meta_base <- metagen(TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = p_subset, common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", sm = "SMD")
      comp_meta      <- update(comp_meta_base, subgroup = p_subset$Neurometabolite_Type)
      pairwise_results <- rbind(pairwise_results, data.frame(
        Group_1 = pair[1], Group_2 = pair[2], Q_Between = comp_meta$Q.b.random, P_Value = comp_meta$pval.Q.b.random, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }, silent = TRUE)
  }
}

comp_label <- "ns" 
if (nrow(pairwise_results) > 0) {
  pairwise_results$FDR_p <- p.adjust(pairwise_results$P_Value, method = "fdr")
  calc_fdr <- pairwise_results$FDR_p[1]
  comp_label <- case_when(
    calc_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
    calc_fdr < 0.01 ~ "**",
    calc_fdr < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}
```

```{r}
    Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c("Primary Progressive", "Relapsing Remitting", "Secondary Progressive"))
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Subtype)

calc_pairwise_p <- function(g1, g2, model) {
  te1 <- model$TE.random.w[g1]
  te2 <- model$TE.random.w[g2]
  se1 <- model$seTE.random.w[g1]
  se2 <- model$seTE.random.w[g2]
  z <- (te1 - te2) / sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2)
  p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
  return(p)
}

p_ppms_rrms <- calc_pairwise_p("Primary Progressive", "Relapsing Remitting", m_ms_joint)
```

##### Figure 5: Anxiety, Depression, EDSS
```{r}
##### ANXIETY #####
### Calculate harmonized scale ###

dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier = case_when(
    !is.na(DASS21_A_case_mean) & DASS21_A_case_mean <= 4  ~ (DASS21_A_case_mean / 4) * 0.25,
    !is.na(DASS21_A_case_mean) & DASS21_A_case_mean <= 6  ~ 0.25 + ((DASS21_A_case_mean - 4) / 2) * 0.25,
    !is.na(DASS21_A_case_mean) & DASS21_A_case_mean <= 10 ~ 0.50 + ((DASS21_A_case_mean - 6) / 4) * 0.25,
    !is.na(DASS21_A_case_mean) & DASS21_A_case_mean <= 21 ~ 0.75 + ((DASS21_A_case_mean - 10) / 11) * 0.25,
    !is.na(HADS_A_case_mean) & HADS_A_case_mean <= 7  ~ (HADS_A_case_mean / 7) * 0.25,
    !is.na(HADS_A_case_mean) & HADS_A_case_mean <= 10 ~ 0.25 + ((HADS_A_case_mean - 7) / 3) * 0.25,
    !is.na(HADS_A_case_mean) & HADS_A_case_mean <= 14 ~ 0.50 + ((HADS_A_case_mean - 10) / 4) * 0.25,
    !is.na(HADS_A_case_mean) & HADS_A_case_mean <= 21 ~ 0.75 + ((HADS_A_case_mean - 14) / 7) * 0.25,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

tissue_column_name <- "Brain_Region_Clean"
target_tissues <- c("Cortical", "Subcortical")
tissue_colors <- c("Cortical" = "#05668d", "Subcortical" = "#a9def9")

combined_data_anx <- dataset_all %>% 
  filter(!!sym(tissue_column_name) %in% target_tissues) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier) & !is.na(SDM) & !is.na(`SDM Std Err`)) %>%
  mutate(Precision_Weight = 1 / (`SDM Std Err` ^ 2))

### Meta-regression ###

if (nrow(combined_data_anx) > 2) {
  
  anxiety_pipelines <- run_continuous_regression_pipeline(
    df = combined_data_anx,
    moderator = "Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier",
    moderator_name = "Harmonized MS Anxiety Severity (Cortical & Subcortical)",
    results_dir = results_dir
  )
  
  # Print out stats
  df_clean_anx <- combined_data_anx %>%
    filter(!is.na(Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier)) %>%
    mutate(temp_mod = as.numeric(Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(temp_mod))

  # Run the meta-regression model from the pipeline
  reg_overall_anx <- metafor::rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = `SDM Std Err`, 
    mods = ~ temp_mod, 
    data = df_clean_anx, 
    method = "DL"
  )

  beta_val <- reg_overall_anx$b[2, 1]   
  ci_lb <- reg_overall_anx$ci.lb[2]         
  ci_ub <- reg_overall_anx$ci.ub[2]
  p_val <- reg_overall_anx$pval[2]         
  r2_val <- reg_overall_anx$R2                   

  p_str <- if (p_val < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val)

  cat(sprintf("Beta (Slope) : %.3f [95%% CI: %.2f to %.2f]\n", beta_val, ci_lb, ci_ub))
  cat(sprintf("p-value      : %s (raw: %.4f)\n", p_str, p_val))
  cat(sprintf("R^2 (%%)     : %.1f%%\n", r2_val))
  
  plot_anx <- ggplot(combined_data_anx, aes(x = Anxiety_Harmonized_4Tier, y = SDM)) +
    stat_smooth(
      method = "lm", 
      formula = y ~ x, 
      aes(weight = Precision_Weight), 
      fullrange = TRUE, 
      alpha = 0.07, 
      fill = "black", 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 0.6,
      geom = "smooth",
      xseq = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200) 
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Precision_Weight, color = !!sym(tissue_column_name)), alpha = 0.7) +

    annotate(
      "text", 
      x = 0.02, y = 4.0, 
      label = "β = 3.42  |  p = 0.001  |  R² = 63.5%", 
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
      size = 4.2, color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Tissue Type", values = tissue_colors) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1")
    ) + 
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("MS – Control Effect Size\n(Cohen's ", italic(d), ")")),
      breaks = seq(-3, 4, by = 1)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-3, 4), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Harmonized Anxiety Severity") +
    
    annotate("segment", x = 0.0, xend = 1.0, y = -4.8, yend = -4.8,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both", type = "closed"),
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = -5.3, label = "Asymptomatic", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "plain") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.98, y = -5.3, label = "Symptomatic", hjust = 1, size = 5, fontface = "plain") +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + 
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8, b = 25), size = 17),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 45, l = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "Harmonized_MS_Anxiety_Cortical_Subcortical_Combined.png"),
    plot     = plot_anx, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300
  )
}

  reg_overall_dep <- metafor::rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = `SDM Std Err`, 
    mods = ~ temp_mod, 
    data = df_clean_dep, 
    method = "DL"
  )

  beta_val_dep <- reg_overall_dep$b[2, 1]   
  ci_lb_dep <- reg_overall_dep$ci.lb[2]         
  ci_ub_dep <- reg_overall_dep$ci.ub[2]
  p_val_dep <- reg_overall_dep$pval[2]              
  r2_val_dep <- reg_overall_dep$R2                   

  p_str_dep <- if (p_val_dep < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p_val_dep)

  cat(sprintf("Beta (Slope) : %.3f [95%% CI: %.2f to %.2f]\n", beta_val_dep, ci_lb_dep, ci_ub_dep))
  cat(sprintf("p-value      : %s (raw: %.4f)\n", p_str_dep, p_val_dep))
  cat(sprintf("R^2 (%%)     : %.1f%%\n", r2_val_dep))
  
  plot_dep <- ggplot(combined_data_dep, aes(x = Depression_Harmonized_4Tier, y = SDM)) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", 
      formula = y ~ x, 
      aes(weight = Precision_Weight), 
      fullrange = TRUE, 
      alpha = 0.07, 
      fill = "black", 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 0.6,
      geom = "smooth",
      xseq = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(size = Precision_Weight, color = !!sym(tissue_column_name)), alpha = 0.7) +

    annotate(
      "text", 
      x = 0.02, y = 4.0, 
      label = "β = 2.47  |  p = 0.01  |  R² = 49.3%", 
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
      size = 4.2,  color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Tissue Type", values = tissue_colors) +
    guides(size = "none") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1")
    ) + 
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("MS – Control Effect Size (Cohen's ", italic(d), ")")),
      breaks = seq(-3, 4, by = 1)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-3, 4), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Harmonized Depression Severity") +
    
    annotate("segment", x = 0.0, xend = 1.0, y = -4.8, yend = -4.8,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both", type = "closed"),
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = -5.3, label = "Asymptomatic", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "plain") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.98, y = -5.3, label = "Symptomatic", hjust = 1, size = 5, fontface = "plain") +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + 
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8, b = 25), size = 17),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 45, l = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "Harmonized_MS_Depression_Cortical_Subcortical_Combined.png"),
    plot     = plot_dep, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300
  )
}

### Meta-regression ###

    df = combined_data_edss,

  )

    filter(!is.na(EDSS_Numeric)) %>%
    mutate(temp_mod = as.numeric(EDSS_Numeric)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(temp_mod))

  # Run the meta-regression model from the pipeline
  reg_overall_edss <- metafor::rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = `SDM Std Err`, 
    mods = ~ temp_mod, 
    data = df_clean_edss, 
    method = "DL"
  )

  beta_val_edss <- reg_overall_edss$b[2, 1]

  cat(sprintf("Beta (Slope) : %.3f [95%% CI: %.2f to %.2f]\n", beta_val_edss, ci_lb_edss, ci_ub_edss))

      name = expression(paste("MS – Control Effect Size (Cohen's ", italic(d), ")")),
```

```{r}
palette_glu_glx <- c("Glu" = "#78a160", "Glx" = "#264a2e")

glu_duration_data <- dataset_all %>%

if (nrow(glu_duration_data) > 0) {
  
  meta_reg <- rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = `SDM Std Err`, 
    mods = ~ Duration_Years, 
    data = glu_duration_data,

  p_string <- if (p_val < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
  
  stats_label <- sprintf("β = %.2f, %s, R² = %.1f%%", beta_val, p_string, r2_val)

  plot_glu_duration <- ggplot(glu_duration_data, aes(x = Duration_Years, y = SDM)) +

      fill = "grey30", 
      color = "black",

    ) +
    
    geom_point(

    ) +
    
    annotate(

      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 1,

      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Metabolite", values = palette_glu_glx) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("Study Weight (", 1/SE^2, ")"))
    ) +
    guides(

    ) +
```

#### MRSQ Data Quality
```{r}
# DEFINE CRITERIA MAPPING
criteria_map <- c(
  "1" = "Tesla Strength", 
  "2" = "Appropriate Sequence", 
  "3" = "Adequate Parameters",
  "4" = "Data Points", 
  "5" = "Quality Measures", 
  "6" = "Data Visualization",
  "7" = "Partial Volume Correction", 
  "8" = "Scanner Drift Report", 
  "9" = "Power Calculation",
  "10" = "Frequency/Phase Correction", 
  "11" = "Software/Analysis"
)

# Data prep ans scoring
quality_data <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(Study_Clean = str_extract(Study, ".*\\d{4}")) %>%
  distinct(Study_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(
    p1 = if_else(Scan_Strength_MRSQ %in% c("3T", "7T"), 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p2 = if_else(str_detect(coalesce(Sequence_MRSQ, ""), regex("PRESS|MEGA|LASER|STEAM", ignore_case = TRUE)), 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p3 = if_else(Scan_Parameters_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p4 = if_else(Data_Points_YN == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p5 = if_else(Quality_Measures_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p6 = if_else(Data_Visualization_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p7 = if_else(Partial_Vol_Correction_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p8 = if_else(Scanner_Drift_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p9 = if_else(Power_calculation_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p10 = if_else(Freq_Phase_Correction_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0),
    p11 = if_else(Analysis_YN_MRSQ == "Y", 1, 0, missing = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Score = rowSums(select(., p1:p11), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Study_Clean) %>%
  mutate(Study_ID = factor(Study_ID, levels = rev(unique(Study_ID))))

study_label_map <- setNames(quality_data$Study_Clean, quality_data$Study_ID)

matrix_long <- quality_data %>%
  select(Study_ID, Study_Clean, p1:p11) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = p1:p11, names_to = "Criteria_Num", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(
    Criteria_Num = factor(str_remove(Criteria_Num, "p"), levels = 1:11),
    Score_Label  = if_else(Score == 1, "Yes", "No")
  )

# Individual panels

# Panel A: Criteria Assessment Matrix
p_matrix <- ggplot(matrix_long, aes(x = Criteria_Num, y = Study_ID, fill = Score_Label)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), labels = study_label_map) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#90be6d", "No" = "#ae2012")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 2, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

# Panel B: Total Criteria Score Column
p_quality <- ggplot(quality_data, aes(x = "Total", y = Study_ID, fill = Total_Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Total_Score), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#a9d6e5", high = "#01497c", limits = c(0, 11)) +

# Panel C: Annotation Legend Key
key_text <- paste(paste0(names(criteria_map), ". ", criteria_map), collapse = "\n")

p_right_panel <- ggplot() +
  # Point Earned Section
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 10.5, label = "Point Earned:", fontface = "bold", size = 4.5, hjust = 0) +
```

#### SDMT
```{r}
##### META-REGRESSION: SDMT SCORE VS METABOLITE EFFECT SIZE #####

palette_glu_glx <- c("Glu" = "#78a160", "Glx" = "#264a2e")

sdmt_smd_data <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    SDMT_Score = as.numeric(SDMT_case_mean),
    SDM = as.numeric(SDM),
    SDM_SE = as.numeric(`SDM Std Err`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SDM) & !is.na(SDM_SE) & !is.na(SDMT_Score)) %>%
  mutate(
    Precision_Weight = 1 / (SDM_SE ^ 2)
  )

if (nrow(sdmt_smd_data) > 0) {
  
  # Run Meta-Regression 
  meta_reg <- rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = SDM_SE, 
    mods = ~ SDMT_Score, 
    data = sdmt_smd_data, 
    method = "DL"
  )
  
  beta_val <- meta_reg$b[2]             
  p_val <- meta_reg$pval[2]          
  r2_val <- max(0, meta_reg$R2)       
  
  p_string <- if (p_val < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
  stats_label <- sprintf("β = %.2f, %s, R² = %.1f%%", beta_val, p_string, r2_val)

  plot_sdmt_smd <- ggplot(sdmt_smd_data, aes(x = SDMT_Score, y = SDM)) +
    
    stat_smooth(
      method = "lm", 
      formula = y ~ x, 
      aes(weight = Precision_Weight), 
      fullrange = TRUE, 
      alpha = 0.07, 
      fill = "grey30", 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    geom_point(
      aes(size = Precision_Weight, color = Neurometabolite_Type), 
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 44, 
      y = 2,
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Metabolite", values = palette_glu_glx) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("Study Weight (", 1/SE^2, ")"))
    ) +
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "grey50", fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.8))
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Mean SDMT Score (MS Patients)",
      limits = c(40, 52),   
      breaks = seq(40, 52, by = 2),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) + 
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("MS - Control Effect Size\n(Cohen's ", italic(d), ")")),
      limits = c(-3, 2),
      breaks = seq(-3, 2, by = 1)
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) + 
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 15, l = 30),
      
      legend.position = "right" 
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "SDMT_vs_Metabolites_SMD_MetaRegression.pdf"),
    plot = plot_sdmt_smd, 
    width = 10, 
    height = 5.2, 
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

#### Cognitive Fatigue 
```{r}
##### META-REGRESSION: MFIS-C SCORE VS METABOLITE EFFECT SIZE #####

palette_glu_glx <- c("Glu" = "#78a160", "Glx" = "#264a2e")

mfis_smd_data <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    MFIS_Score = as.numeric(MFIS_C_case_mean),
    SDM = as.numeric(SDM),
    SDM_SE = as.numeric(`SDM Std Err`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SDM) & !is.na(SDM_SE) & !is.na(MFIS_Score)) %>%
  mutate(
    Precision_Weight = 1 / (SDM_SE ^ 2)
  )

if (nrow(mfis_smd_data) > 0) {
  
  # Run Meta-Regression
  meta_reg <- rma(
    yi = SDM, 
    sei = SDM_SE, 
    mods = ~ MFIS_Score, 
    data = mfis_smd_data, 
    method = "DL"
  )
  
  beta_val <- meta_reg$b[2]
  p_val <- meta_reg$pval[2]
  r2_val <- max(0, meta_reg$R2)
  
  p_string <- if (p_val < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
  stats_label <- sprintf("β = %.2f, %s, R² = %.1f%%", beta_val, p_string, r2_val)

  pred_grid <- data.frame(MFIS_Score = seq(13.8, 17, length.out = 100))
  preds <- predict(meta_reg, newmods = pred_grid$MFIS_Score)
  
  pred_df <- data.frame(
    MFIS_Score = pred_grid$MFIS_Score,

    ci.lb = preds$ci.lb,

      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(name = "Metabolite", values = palette_glu_glx) +
    
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("Study Weight (", 1/SE^2, ")"))
    ) +
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "grey50", fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.8))

    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Mean MFIS-C Score (MS Cases)",

    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(paste("MS - Control Effect Size\n(Cohen's ", italic(d), ")")),
      limits = c(-3, 3),
      breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) + 
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 15, l = 30),
      
      legend.position = "right" 
    )

  ggsave(

  )
}
```

### Funnel Plots
```{r}
contour_lvls <- c(0.9, 0.95, 0.99)
col_contour  <- c("gray75", "gray85", "gray95")
col_contour2 = c("#4682B4", "#6699CC", "#b3cee5") 
legend_text  <- c("p < 0.1", "p < 0.05", "p < 0.01")

# Ensure the sensitivity folder exists
sens_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Sensitivity_Tests")
if (!dir.exists(sens_dir)) dir.create(sens_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (metabolite in all_metabolites) {
  meta_result <- metab_metaresults[[metabolite]]
  
  if (is.null(meta_result)) next
  
  message(paste("Generating QA Funnel Plot for:", metabolite))
  
  pdf_path <- file.path(sens_dir, paste0("funnel_plot_", metabolite, ".pdf"))
  pdf(pdf_path, width = 8, height = 7)
  
  par(las = 1, mar = c(5, 7, 4, 2), lwd = 2)
  
  meta::funnel(
    meta_result, 
    yaxis = "se", 
    xlab = "Effect Size (Cohen's d)", 
    main = paste0(metabolite),
    comb.fixed = FALSE, 
    comb.random = TRUE, 
    lty.random = 1, 
    pch = 21, 
    col = "black", 
    bg = "white",  
    xlim = c(-2, 2), 
    contour = contour_lvls, 
    col.contour = col_contour2, 
    studlab = FALSE,
    cex.main = 2.2,   
    cex.lab  = 1.8,  
    cex.axis = 1.5,  
    lwd = 2
  )
  
  legend("topright", 
         legend = legend_text, 
         fill = col_contour2, 
         title = "Significance", 
         cex = 1.4,        
         y.intersp = 1.2,  
         x.intersp = 1.1,
         bty = "o", 
         bg = "white")
  
  dev.off()
}
```

#### Begg Test
<https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/meta/versions/4.15-1/topics/metabias.meta>

```{r}
for (metabolite in all_metabolites) {
  meta_result <- metab_metaresults[[metabolite]]
  
  if (is.null(meta_result)) {
    message(paste("Skipping Begg's test for", metabolite, "- result not found."))
    next
  }

  message(paste("Running Begg's Test for:", metabolite))

  begg_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("begg_test_", metabolite, ".txt"))
  
  sink(begg_file)
  
  cat("Begg's Rank Correlation Test for Publication Bias \n")
  cat("Metabolite:", metabolite, "\n\n")
  
  # metabias with method.bias = "rank" is the Begg's test
  test_output <- metabias(meta_result, method.bias = "rank", correct = FALSE)
  print(test_output)
  
  sink()
}

# Overall
begg_file_overall <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("begg_test_overall.txt"))
  
  sink(begg_file_overall)
  
  cat("Begg's Rank Correlation Test for Publication Bias \n")
  cat("Overall \n\n")
  
  test_output <- metabias(meta_results, method.bias = "rank", correct = FALSE)
  print(test_output)
  
  sink()
```

#### Egger's Test and Trim & Fill
<https://bookdown.org/MathiasHarrer/Doing_Meta_Analysis_in_R/smallstudyeffects.html>

```{r}
### Egger's Test ###

  egger_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("eggers_test_overall.txt"))
  
  sink(egger_file)
  cat("Egger's Test for Funnel Plot Asymmetry \n")
  cat("Overall \n\n")
  
  # metamerge/metabias logic: method.bias = "linreg" is Egger's
  tryCatch({
    test_output <- metabias(meta_results, method.bias = "linreg")
    print(test_output)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error running Egger's test: Likely too few studies (k) for regression.")
  })
  
  sink()

### Duval & Tweedie's Trim-and-Fill Procedure ###
  
  tf_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("trimfill_test_overall.txt"))
  
  sink(tf_file)
  cat("Duval & Tweedie's Trim-and-Fill Procedure \n")
  cat("Overall \n\n")
  
  tf_result <- trimfill(meta_results, common = FALSE, random = TRUE)
  print(tf_result)
  
  cat("\nComparison of Original vs. Adjusted Random Effects ")
  cat("\nAdjusted SMD:", round(tf_result$TE.random, 3))
  
  sink()


```

#### Fail safe N
<https://rdrr.io/cran/metafor/man/fsn.html>
```{r}
  yi_vector <- as.numeric(meta_results$TE)
  vi_vector <- as.numeric(meta_results$seTE^2)
  
  fsn_results <- metafor::fsn(x = yi_vector, vi = vi_vector, type = "Rosenthal")

  fsn_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("Fail_safe_N_test_overall.txt"))
  
  sink(fsn_file)
  cat("Rosenthal's Fail-Safe N Analysis \n")
  cat("Number of studies (k):", meta_results$k, "\n\n")
  
  print(fsn_results)
  
  threshold <- 5 * meta_results$k + 10
  cat("\nInterpretation \n")
  cat("Tolerance Level (5k + 10):", threshold, "\n")
  if (fsn_results$fsnum > threshold) {
    cat("Result is ROBUST: Fail-safe N is greater than the threshold.")
  } else {
    cat("Result is FRAGILE: Fail-safe N is less than the threshold.")
  }
  
  sink()


```
